d:
Been working on this over the last month or so, This short doujin is part of an Art Trade with a friend of mine.

The story is a group of my own characters and a group of their characters get transported to a beautiful beach from their respective worlds. From my world we have Fumiko, Kujou, Mayu and Astraea. From my friends world we have Jackie, Sabrina, Amber and Luzia. At first everyone was on guard and ready for a potential fight, but the relaxing setting allowed everyone to cool down the tension and instead collaborate for the time that they are stuck here together. Though it seems their form of "collaboration" involves a lot of sex~
